claims.speaker: Heidi Crane
claims.sentence: In the third quarter, net revenue was $58.6 million, a decrease of 20% year-over-year, driven by a decrease in total orders placed and the impact of higher return rates, partially offset by an increase in wholesale revenue.

claims.speaker: Heidi Crane
claims.sentence: Our net loss for the third quarter was $4.3 million compared to a net loss of $2.3 million in the same period last year.
